notes: Schéma methods-per-subject (@studyy.hackz : 587 k vues le 06/10, 277 k le 30/09, preuve valable jusqu'au 5/11). slides.texte_overlay:
“I understand it in class
but forget it by the test”

same. it's not your memory, it's your method.
here's what to use for each subject...

Redo the examples ✏️
Best for: Maths, Physics, Accounting
cover the solution of an example from class and solve it yourself. then compare step by step.

Timelines 🗓️
Best for: History, Literature
draw one line across the page with the dates. causes above the line, consequences below.

Question cards 🃏
Best for: Biology, Languages, Law
write a question on one side, the answer on the other. say the answer out loud BEFORE you flip.

Look away and say it 🗣️
Best for: Languages
read a sentence, look away, say it again from memory. if you can't say it, you don't know it yet.

Mistake log 📒
Best for: Maths, Chemistry, Grammar
keep one page with every mistake you made and why. reread it the night before the test.

Silent study block 🔕
Best for: Essays, long readings
notifications off, social media closed for the whole block. every "quick check" resets your focus.
